Name: Li'l Sebastian Replacement Portrait
Author: feralfinch
Description:
[size=2][i]**Refined my work a bit. No major changes.[/i][/size]

Hello! I'm an artist who recently started playing Stardew Valley and fell in love. When I discovered portrait mods and how easy they were to implement, I wanted to try my hand. So I have created a series of vanilla inspired characters with a little more detail and a little more flare. Sebastian was the first so his is slightly less refined than the others but I may update. Others to come as I finish fiddling and packing files.

+ Requires Content Patcher & SMAPI
[list]
[*]Download my file and unzip
[*]Extract folder into steam/steamapps/common/stardewvalley/mods
[*]Content Patcher must have been run at least once for mods to take effect
[/list]
[size=4]My Bachelor Portrait Mods:[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5400]
